final_answer:
The argumentation put forward several opinions in favor of AI:

1) AI is beneficial to everyday life.  
- Opinion: AI can make daily life more enjoyable and convenient.  
- Intended support: This directly improves quality of life for society.

2) AI improves health and living standards.  
- Opinion: AI can improve our health and standard of living.  
- Intended support: Together with the previous point, this leads to the conclusion that AI improves societal well-being.

3) AI helps people with work and education.  
- Opinion: AI makes work easier for students and professionals alike.  
- Intended support: When combined with improved quality of life, this supports the broader claim that AI contributes to social well-being through education and productivity.

4) AI supports marginalized groups and accessibility.  
- Opinion: AI helps marginalized groups—especially people with disabilities—by providing accessibility.  
- Intended support: Combined with education/productivity benefits, this supports inclusion and equal opportunity.

5) AI can improve workplace safety.  
- Opinion: AI can improve workplace safety.  
- Intended support: Paired with inclusion/equal opportunity, this supports the final claim that AI is good for society.

No objections were raised in the provided argumentation log, so there were no explicit counterpoints to address. The conclusion was asserted through a chain of positive implications leading to: “AI is good for society.”

Final answer:  
Yes—artificial intelligence can be good for society. It can make everyday life more convenient and enjoyable, improve health and overall living standards, and reduce burdens for students and professionals by making tasks easier. It can also promote inclusion by improving accessibility for people with disabilities, and it may enhance workplace safety through better detection, monitoring, and risk management. Overall, the argument supports the view that AI—when used appropriately—helps raise quality of life, expand equal opportunities, and strengthen safer, more productive communities.
